extras.Title: Infinite search spinner & profile load timeout on /app/mock-test
extras.Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as PRO_USER_01.
2. Navigate to https://trycareerpilot.com/app/mock-test.
3. Observe the search bar and DevTools Console.
4. Type any search keyword (e.g., "ssc") into the search box.
extras.Expected: Profile data loads cleanly without errors, the search bar finishes initializing, and entering a keyword filters/returns relevant exam test papers.
extras.Actual: Search bar shows an infinite loading spinner and gets stuck displaying "Searching...". DevTools Console throws multiple errors: "[clarify:auth:profile:load_timed_out]" and "[authStore] Failed to load profile".

extras.Title: Missing DialogTitle accessibility prop in Quick Search modal throws repeated console errors on click
extras.Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as PRO_USER_01.
2. Navigate to any page (e.g., https://trycareerpilot.com/app/guide/practice-coach).
3. Open DevTools Console panel.
4. Click on the global search input bar ("Search pages, actions, settings...").
5. Observe the DevTools Console.
extras.Expected: Global search modal overlay opens cleanly with full screen reader accessibility support and zero console errors.
extras.Actual: Search modal opens, but DevTools console immediately logs repeated Radix UI runtime errors: "`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users" along with missing `aria-describedby` warnings.

extras.Title: Razorpay risk detection script blocked by Content Security Policy (CSP) on checkout modal
extras.Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as PRO_USER_01.
2. Navigate to https://trycareerpilot.com/app/settings/billing.
3. Open DevTools Console panel.
4. Click on 'Buy Max (one-time)' button to trigger checkout.
5. Observe DevTools Console.
extras.Expected: Payment modal opens and all third-party vendor dependencies (Razorpay scripts) load cleanly without CSP or header access violations.
extras.Actual: Console throws CSP violation error: Loading script 'https://cdn.razorpay.com/static/cx/razorpay-risk-detection/bundle.js' violates directive 'script-src'. Action blocked along with unsafe header errors.
